information.title: About Cloud Duster
information.description: How many of the photos stored in your cloud do you actually look at? A cloud full of accumulated photos becomes not a treasure chest of memories, but a heavy box of clutter. The reason we don't delete photos often comes from two overlapping feelings: the fear that we might need them someday, and the reluctance to let go of memories. Here at Cloud Duster, take a moment to dust off the layers of digital dust in your cloud, reflect on why we take photos, and organize the side effects left behind by countless life shots.
